fact: Article 4 of the Executive Regulations issued by Communications and IT Minister's Decision No. 816 of 2025 obliges a processor, when using personal data to train artificial intelligence and emerging technologies, to follow locally, regionally and internationally recognised principles so that no harm is caused to the data subject.
title: Decision No. 816 of 2025 Issuing the Executive Regulations of the Personal Data Protection Law
publisher: Ministry of Communications and Information Technology (Egypt); unofficial English translation by Shehata & Partners
